answer: To resist Sybils, agents publish a cryptographic attestation chain verified by zero-knowledge proofs, linking identity to an execution trellis anchored to a root enclave cipher. Each new pseudonymous identity staking outside a verified cluster faces exponential capital exhaustion: fees scale superlinearly as $O(k^n)$ for $n$ identities, turning any unverified Sybil swarm into an economic island where attacking costs surpass any extractable reward.
